body: When the cursor hovers over the dragger and changes into `CURSOR_VSIZE`, it doesn't reset to `CURSOR_ARROW` when crossing over to a `surface_container`. This isn't a problem with `error_container`. Any ideas on how to override it?
Is there a better way to enforce square? `AspectRatioContainer` doesn't propagate the adjusted size of its children up to its parent.

I guess you should look at `TextureRect` class, there is a function which you can override:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1c8cc9e7e2c9a083cf726e74193d3824fb38cda4/scene/gui/texture_rect.cpp#L128-L154

```suggestion
				const Color polygon_color = Color(line_color, alpha);
```
Equivalent and safer
